name: leaks
description: Notices personal identifiers and secrets that reach the model, lists them per project, and can redact or block them, with modes and ignore lists per folder

mode.title: Default mode
mode.description: Mode where no rule applies. redact (default): replace each value with a placeholder before the model reads it; notify: record and notify only; block: withhold content and refuse prompts that hold such data; off: no scan

rules.title: Modes per folder
rules.description: Comma-separated folder=mode entries, for example ~/clients/acme=block, ~/perso=off; the deepest folder holding a path wins, and a file read takes the stricter of the session's mode and its own folder's

failClosed.title: Fail closed
failClosed.description: In redact and block modes, withhold content when a scan fails or runs out of time instead of letting it through

notify.title: Notification
notify.description: How a new finding is announced: toast in Claude Code, system notification, both, or off

storeRawValues.title: Keep full values
storeRawValues.description: Keep full personal identifiers in the history instead of masked ones; secrets stay masked

ignore.title: Ignored everywhere
ignore.description: Comma-separated entries; a finding whose value or source matches one is skipped. * stands for any characters: *@acme.com ignores a whole domain

folderIgnore.title: Ignored per folder
folderIgnore.description: Comma-separated folder=entry|entry items, for example ~/clients/acme=*@acme.com|noreply@*; they apply to content tied to that folder, on top of the global list

retentionDays.title: History kept (days)
retentionDays.description: Days of history kept before older occurrences are deleted
